anomalies.label: SOL–CENTAURI BEARING
anomalies.subtitle: Home System · Twin Golden Reference
anomalies.description: Ten light-years behind you, Sol and Alpha Centauri burn steady in visible light. Step inside to trace the orbital bearings and prove the horizon curvature points straight back home.

anomalies.label: CARINA RIFT NURSERY
anomalies.subtitle: Dust-Veiled Stellar Cliffs
anomalies.description: Opaque molecular dust hides this stellar nursery in visible light. Sweep into mid-infrared to peel back the dark veil and hear the newborn stars pulsing behind it.

anomalies.label: CLUSTER J1419-A
anomalies.subtitle: Gravitational Lens & Horizon Seam
anomalies.description: A massive foreground cluster bends ancient starlight into bright arcs. Enter the lens to unwarp the rings and expose the unnatural geometric seam hidden behind them.

anomalies.label: PULSAR RIFT S-04
anomalies.subtitle: High-Energy Shock & Repeating Facet
anomalies.description: Invisible to ordinary human eyes, violent ultraviolet and X-ray jets flare along the far edge of the survey sphere—repeating the exact same curvature radius as J1419-A.
